description: A Brilliantly Devised Plan? Last Flag is a fun-first 5v5 shooter set in a 1970s-inspired game show where larger-than-life contestants compete for fame and fortune in the ultimate game of capture the flag. Jump into the open beta February 9 - March 2. https://epic.gm/last-flag-demo
title: Last Flag | A Brilliantly Devised Plan

author: Epic Games
description:
The Huaxu Version – The Wind Awakening · Part II officially launches on February 10 on the Epic Games Store! https://epic.gm/dna

✦ New Characters & Weapons Available  New characters Zhiliu and Yuming will become available, with new weapons and Demon Wedges released simultaneously!     
✦ New Skins & Accessories Added  Winter reveries, renewed styles!  The Frosty Fantasy snowbound adventure style, the Fleeting Traces academy journey style, along with a series of exquisite accessories, are making their debut!     
✦ New Limited Myriad Outfit  Moonlit shadows dance as gilded splendor graces the night—  Epulary Elegance, Zhiliu's brand-new qipao outfit, arrives in dazzling style!     
✦ New Mounts Added  Ride without limits—charge boldly ahead!  The Blade-run Knight heavy motorcycle, the adorable Filbert, let's go go go! mount, and the Mecha-Taihao argent loong mount are all arriving on the wind!
title: Duet Night Abyss | Huaxu Version – The Wind Awakening · Part II Trailer

author: Epic Games
description:
The war with Pax Armata escalates into the mountains of Germany.

Launching February 17, forces clash in a brutal push to reclaim a once-held NATO airbase, triggering a wider global conflict where control of territory comes at any cost.
title: Battlefield 6 Season 2 | Intro Cinematic
